release_notes: Build 92 adds Archive completed C to Quiz History for safely moving every fully-uploaded C: quiz project into Z:\FactVaultManager\Quizzes.
The bulk preview separates ready projects from quizzes that still have required uploads outstanding; upload-incomplete projects stay on C: and are not changed.

If an existing Z: project has the complete same relative file list and every file size matches, Factburst reuses that verified copy, updates Quiz History, and only then removes the redundant C: folder.
If no fully identical Z: copy can be verified, Factburst creates a new copy, verifies it, updates Quiz History, and only then removes the C: source.
Existing Z: folders are never overwritten or deleted; name collisions automatically use archived-copy NNN destinations.
Projects referenced by multiple Quiz History rows are safety-skipped, and each project is rechecked for upload completion and path changes immediately before archiving.
Successful bulk archive path changes are added to the independent archive relink journal so Diagnostics can detect a later database/path rollback.
Build 91 added archive/database Diagnostics, and Build 90 added faster cached archive matching.
